description: This Java class defines a command named ModifyFeatureDefinition within the Eclipse Ditto project. It is used to modify the definition of a feature of a thing, including serialization/deserialization logic, value accessors, and metadata annotations. The class extends base command classes, manages JSON representations, and references various Ditto model components.
